name: Infinite Slider
description: Full-width draggable image slider that loops endlessly, with a large animated slide counter, previous and next buttons with corner-bracket hover, and captions on the active slide.
contents: Row of image slides with caption tags
behavior: Slides loop infinitely and can be dragged with inertia, snapping to the closest slide
Clicking a slide or the arrow buttons glides to it with easing
Active slide is fully opaque with its caption sliding in, others are dimmed
Counter digits scroll vertically to the current step
Below 768px the counter and buttons move to the bottom of the slider
editableByProps: Number of slides, images and captions
Loop speed and button transition classes

needsCodeEdit.change: Change slide size or aspect ratio
Change the dimmed look of inactive slides
needsCodeEdit.where: opacity-20 and [&.active]:opacity-100 classes on the slide element
draggable: true option in the horizontalLoop call

fixed: Slide counter and buttons are overlaid on the left with a dark gradient on desktop
Sizes scale with the viewport width through the root font size, with a 9px minimum
Includes an Archivo Black @font-face rule from the source
Requires gsap with the Draggable and InertiaPlugin modules
